FcmToken.title: FCM Token
FcmToken.description: User device registration token for Firebase Cloud Messaging push notifications

userId.description: Unique identifier of the employee user

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last token update

ShiftReminder.title: Shift Reminder
ShiftReminder.description: Notification reminder schedule for employee clock-in and clock-out

exitTime.description: Time string in HH:mm format for exit clock-out reminder

days.description: Comma-separated list of active reminder days (e.g. 1,2,3,4,5)
